SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLAN, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM PURCHASE_IN_TMP WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N') GROUP BY PLAN, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'DGIL' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(A.PLAN,' ') AS PLAN, A.LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(A.STATUS, 'D') AS STATUS, NVL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(A.GR_QUN, 0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(A.GR_AMT, 0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(A.GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE FROM PURCHASE_IN_TMP A WHERE A.IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PLAN = '$G_RS.PLAN$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' ORDER BY A.PLAN,A.LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE PURCHASE_IN_TMP SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PLAN = '$G_RS.PLAN$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
